title: Houston Hollow Heart Hauntings Ghost Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Houston’s #1 Ghost Tour—an authentic, thrilling, and hauntingly fun experience! Are you ready to reveal Houston’s darkest secrets? Join us for a spine-chilling, wildly fun walking ghost tour through the city's most haunted and historic spots. Led by expert local guides—Houston’s official haunted history experts—you’ll hear real, bone-chilling stories of Houston’s eerie past and the spirits that still roam today.

Our nightly, year-round tours uncover centuries of wicked history as we visit Houston’s most haunted buildings and bars. Hear captivating tales of notorious spirits, infamous murders, and scandalous events. Stroll through darkened streets, and let our guides bring chilling stories to life as you explore iconic locations like La Carafe, the Donnellan Family Crypt, and Old Magnolia Brewery Building.

Each step through Houston’s historic district connects you to its eerie past. While we don’t enter buildings, you’ll feel the energy of haunted hotspots beneath your feet.
